title: WHO: 1.1 billion people were living with obesity in 2024
summary: WHO's obesity fact sheet, dated 7 October 2026, says 1 in 7 people had obesity in 2024, and it calls obesity a chronic disease.
body: WHO's obesity and overweight fact sheet, dated 7 October 2026, says that in 2024, 1 in 7 people, 1.1 billion, were living with obesity. It says worldwide adult obesity has more than doubled since 1990, and adolescent obesity has quadrupled. It says that in 2024, 45 percent of adults 18 and over, 2.6 billion, were overweight, and that of these, 940 million were living with obesity, 16 percent of all adults. The overview calls obesity a chronic disease affecting 1.1 billion people. Those are WHO's figures and WHO's wording. This card does not add a definition of the body-mass cutoff the sheet did not print in the key facts.
